module UnpackStrategy
  # Strategy for unpacking Microsoft Office documents.
  class MicrosoftOfficeXml < Uncompressed
    sig { override.returns(T::Array[String]) }
    def self.extensions
      [
        ".doc", ".docx",
        ".ppt", ".pptx",
        ".xls", ".xlsx"
      ]
    end

    sig { override.params(path: Pathname).returns(T::Boolean) }
